programme.desc: Deze documentaire vertelt het opvallende levensverhaal van de Roemeense pianist Clara Haskil. Ze werd in Boekarest geboren in een Joodse familie, waar zij al vroeg als wonderkind werd opgemerkt en aan het Conservatorium werd toegelaten.
programme.title: Clara Haskil : le mystère de l'interprète

programme.desc: Azerbaijan. "Shusha, the Renaissance" is a musical journey featuring pianist Murad Huseynov. The city of Shusha is often considered the cradle of Azerbaijan's music and poetry and one of the leading centres of the Azerbaijani culture, having been declared the cultural capital of Azerbaijan in January 2021. On the program are the following works: Fikret Amirov's (1922-1984) Twelve Miniatures for Piano Solo: I. Ballade - II. Ashigsayagi - III. Nocturne - IV. Humoresque - V. Lyrical Dance - VI. Hunting - VII. Lullaby - VIII. Waltz - IX. Barcarolle - X. Toccata - XI. Elegy - XII. March; Adil Babirov's (1934-2021) 's Prelude & Scherzo; Gara Garayev's (1918-1982) Sonatine: I. Allegro - II. Moderato assai - III. Vivo ; Tofik Kouliyev's (1917-2000) 'Gaytagi' and F. Amirov's Romantic Sonata: I. Allegro energico - II. Andante espressivo - III. Allegro non troppo). This performance is filmed in Shusha in October 2023 and in the Heydar Aliyev Center, Baku, in December 2023. Written and directed by Michel Swierczewski.
programme.title: Shusha Renaissance (2023)

programme.desc: Château de Chantilly, France. On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. As part of this concert, the 'Grande Dame' of the piano is joined by violinists Maxim Vengerov and Tedi Papavrami, cellist Mischa Maisky, and her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola in a performance of Robert Schumann's Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44. This performance was recorded on June 11, 2021.
programme.title: Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44

programme.desc: Notre-Dame de Paris. Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally. He sees himself as an ambassador of French music from the 17th through the 20th centuries as well as an advocate for the art of improvisation. Pieces played in the film are: Pierre Cochereau's Boléro, Louis Vierne's Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant's Sonata No. 1, Charles-Marie Widor's Gothic Symphony, Marcel Dupre's Cortege, Litanie and J. S. Bach's Passacaille & Fugue.
programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach

programme.desc: Italy. After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a "Concerto for piano without orchestra", in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles. In 1853, Schumann revised the work and added a Scherzo as a second movement. The final movement is reminiscent of Schumann's earlier composition Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.
programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14

programme.desc: Philharmonie, Paris. Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.
programme.title: Classica Spotlight

programme.desc: Norway. The 2019 documentary 'Approaching the Maelström' follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass's composition 'A Descent into the Maelström'. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe's 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway. Glass's work, originally a choral piece for the Australian Dance Theatre, was only ever performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Over thirty years later, in 2019, Beacon Isle Films recorded a symphonic arrangement of Glass's work, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss with soprano Berit Norbakken Solset as the soloist. Their recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story. Moreover, this inspiring documentary features a rare interview with Glass.
programme.title: Approaching the Maelström

programme.desc: Cité de la musique, Paris, France. Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébene marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébene explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébene performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 12, Op. 127

programme.desc: Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Florence, Italy. Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvorák's broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.
programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70

programme.desc: Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the occasion of International Women's Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven's Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op. 24; Manuel de Falla's Suite Populaire Espagnole (transcription by Paul Kochaniski); Camille Saint-Saëns' Introduction and Rondo Capriccioso in A minor, Op. 28; and 'Méditation' from Jules Massenet's opera Thais. This performance was recorded on March 8, 2022.
programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o

programme.desc: Germany. Lithuanian pianist Vadim Chaimovich (*1978) has won several prizes at international piano competitions, such as the Schubert Competition in Dortmund, the William Kapell International Piano Competition in Maryland, and the 29th Masterplayers International Music Competition in Lugano. Moreover, the pianist has performed in several European countries, Japan, and the USA , and has played at many international music festivals. In the current recital, Chaimovich performs piano works by Anton Bruckner. On the program are Klavierstück in E-flat major, WAB 119, Erinnerung in A-flat major, WAB 117, Lancier-Quadrille Nos. 1, 2, 3 & 4 in C major, WAB 120, Steiermärker in G major, WAB 122, Stille Betrachtung an einem Herbstabend ('Quiet meditation on an autumn evening') in F-sharp minor, WAB 123, Fantasie in G major, WAB 118, and Piano sonata in G minor, WAB 243.
programme.title: Piano works by Bruckner

credits.actor: Fabio Luisi & Danish National Symphony Orchestra

programme.desc: DR Koncerthuset, Copenhagen, Denmark. This live performance marks Fabio Luisi's very first concert with the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in DR Koncerthuset, Copenhagen. Beethoven's fantastic Eroica symphony is a milestone in classical music, and with Stravinsky's mighty Symphony of Psalms and Strauss' virtuosic Don Juan, this production fully demonstrates the unique chemistry between Fabio Luisi and the orchestra of which he today is the celebrated Chief Conductor. This performance was recorded in 2017.
programme.title: Stravinsky - Symphony of Psalms

programme.desc: Een uitvoering van het derde Brandenburgs concert. Bach droeg zijn zes Brandenburgs concerten op aan de Markgraaf van Brandenburg. Het derde concert schreef hij voor drie violen, drie altviolen, drie cello's en een basso continuo begeleiding.
programme.title: Bach: Brandenburg Concerto No. 3

programme.desc: Teatro Romano di Verona, Italy. In multidisciplinary project 'Preludes - Danze al pianoforte', dance and music come together in a wonderful and sophisticated show. Recognized Italian choreographer Massimo Moricone choreographed some of the most beautiful piano pieces by Frédéric Chopin, Claude Debussy, J. S. Bach, and Sergei Rachmaninoff, played by Italian pianist Costanza Principe. The protagonists are three Italy's finest dancers: Anbeta Toromani, Alessandro Macario, and Amilcar Moret Gonzales. This performance was recorded at Teatro Romano di Verona, Italy, on July 25, 2023.
programme.title: Preludes - Danze al pianoforte

programme.desc: Cité de la musique, Paris, France. Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébene marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébene explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébene performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 3 in D major, Op. 18 No. 3; String Quartet No. 11 in F minor, Op. 95, "Quartetto Serioso"; and String Quartet No. 8 in E minor, Op. 59, No. 2, "Razumovsky". This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 23, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 3, 8 & 11

programme.desc: Auditorium de Lyon, France. American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.
programme.title: Slatkin conducts Bolcom, Beethoven & Ravel

programme.desc: Italy. After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece's title refers to humor as an emotional state. Schumann took his inspiration from German Romantic writer Jean Paul, who defines humor as "an infinity of contrast", "a setting of the small world beside the great", and where "a kind of laughter results which contains pain and greatness". Humoreske is one continuous piece consisting of contrasting sections. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.
programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20

programme.desc: Café Sperl, Vienna. Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kovác. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.
programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna

programme.desc: Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland. Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, "Eroica". The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55

programme.desc: Milan, Italy. After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann's Kreisleriana, Op. 16. Schumann claimed that he penned this 1838 composition in just four days. He dedicated it to Frédéric Chopin, his contemporary. The work's title refers to the musician Johannes Kreisler, a fictional character from the writings of German Romantic author E. T. A. Hoffmann. Schumann regarded the composition as one of his finest. Kreisleriana is a dramatic, eight-movement piece. Its contrasting sections invoke the imaginary musician's violent mood swings as well as the conflict between Schumann's own two fictional characters, Florestan and Eusebius, which represent the duality of the composer's own personality. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.
programme.title: Schumann - Kreisleriana, Op. 16

The program continues with Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 with the Orchester de Paris, directed by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra and the next musical director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.desc: Cité de la musique, Paris, France. Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébene marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébene explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébene performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 5, Op. 18, No. 5

programme.desc: Various. The documentary "Clara Haskil - Le mystere de l'interprete" (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil's fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition. She performed as a soloist over the world with the foremost orchestras, and collaborated with acclaimed musicians including Eugene Ysaye, George Enescu, and Pablo Casals.
programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystere de l'interprete

programme.desc: Italy. After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann's Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods. The work's title is derived from one of the composer's favourite authors' collection of novellas: E. T. A. Hoffmann's Fantasiestücke in Callots Manier. Like Schumann's Davidsbündlertänze, his Fantasiestücke are designed as a musical dialogue between Florestan and Eusebius, representing the duality of his own personality. The former represents the composer's passionate side, and the latter depicts the dreamer in Schumann. Acclaimed pianist Riccardo Schwartz (1986) has performed as a soloist with many world-renowned conductors, including Gustav Kuhn and Yuri Temirkanov. His acclaimed performances include recitals and concertos for piano and orchestra in many prestigious concert halls.
programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12

programme.desc: Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Perugia, Italy. Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. The work premiered at the Viennese Burgtheater on April 1, 1784, with the composer himself at the piano. Shortly after the performance, Mozart wrote to his father Leopold, "I consider it the best work I have ever written..." Striking is the Quintet's unusual instrumentation, which presented the composer with a challenge "as single winds, as opposed to pairs, pose problems of blend". Therefore, Mozart explored numerous different permutations of instruments to produce various sonorities, and used short phrases and motifs for variety. This performance was recorded at Perugia's Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.
programme.title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452

programme.desc: Tchaikovsky Concert Hall, Moscow, Russia. The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow. The programme includes George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue and Rachmaninov's Rhapsody on a Theme by Paganini and is produced by the Moscow Philharmonic Society, which Saint Petersburg-born composer Dmitri Shostakovich himself once described as playing a significant role "in the development of musical life [in Russia]. It is a kind of university which is attended by millions of music lovers and thousands of musicians." The Moscow Philharmonic Society was founded in 1922 by then-Commissar for Culture, Anatoly Lunacharsky, and has over the years come to be Russia's leading concert organizing institution.
programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies

programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.desc: Philharmonie am Gasteig, Munich, Germany. 'MĂźnchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music â not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1987, American pianist Armando Anthony "Chick" Corea was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Frank Gambale on guitar, Eric Marienthal on saxophone, John Patitucci on bass and Dave Weckl on drums, Corea performed jazz fusion with his Elektric Band - a jazz subgenre inspired by the rock music and electronic instruments of the day. The band was nominated for two Grammy Awards.

programme.desc: Auditorio Ruy de Carvalho, Carnaxide, Portugal. Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called âAlma Novaâ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, âLuz Destinoâ and âSenhora da Lapaâ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone. After that, she continued her career with the release of âNome de Marâ, which received many positive reviews. At the moment, Maria Ana is performing at all Portugalâs major venues, as well as many festivals and concert halls throughout the world, with the aim to present fado music and Portuguese culture to other cultures. Boboneâs latest album, âFado & Pianoâ, shows her diversity as an artist, composer and arranger. By including the piano she re-innovates the tradition of the early 20th century. This portrait shows Maria Anaâs performances and interviews in which she explains her passion for fado music and culture.

Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement âtropicalismoâ. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

Dit portret van Marcus Miller werd in 2009 opgenomen tijdens zijn tournee 'Tutu Revisited'. Hij blikt terug op zijn samenwerking met Miles Davis. Ook vertelt hij over zijn compositie 'Tutu', en legt hij uit hoe het gelijknamige album tot stand kwam.

programme.desc: In 1987 opende de populaire gitarist George Benson met zijn band de derde dag van het North Sea Jazz Festival in Den Haag. Hij werd bijgestaan door Earl Klugh op akoestisch gitaar. Zij speelden materiaal van hun gezamenlijke album Collaborations.

programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra : Estival Jazz Lugano

programme.title: Medley
North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: North Sea Jazz, The Hague, The Netherlands. The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, R&B, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976. This broadcast from the North Sea Jazz Archives presents the great Wayne Shorter Quartet. Shorterâs maxim is to reinvent his music during each concert. He means to give his music a radical originality.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers

programme.desc: Estival Jazz, Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. Her career flourished in the US, where she released several albums. Makeba was among the first African musicians to receive worldwide recognition. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres. Her performances at Estival Lugano is beyond incredible. Her voice, the power and the soul summarizes her musicality in 40 minutes, together with her band and extremely talented backing-vocals.
programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985

programme.desc: Jazz Ă Vienne Festival, France. For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.
programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond

programme.desc: Various locations. Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Petersonâs virtuosity as his trio plays âC-Jam Bluesâ in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets AntonĂ­n DvoĹĂĄk's âHumoresqueâ in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monkâs enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition âRound About Midnightâ in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered âTake Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of âSweet and Lovelyâ at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of âSlyâ in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's âSong for my Fatherâ performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!
programme.title: Great Jazz Pianists

programme.desc: Da PĂĄ Virada Studios, SÄo Paulo, Brazil. Da PĂĄ Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in SĂŁo Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Trio Corrente, which was formed in 2001, consisting of Fabio Torres on piano, Paulo Paulelli on bass, and Edu Ribeiro on drums. Since then, the trio has been creating an original sound playing the classics of choro and MĂssica Popular Brasileira.
programme.title: Trio Corrente - Da PĂĄ Virada Sessions

programme.desc: Newport Jazz Festival, Rotterdam, The Netherlands. The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1972, an outstanding lineup played shoulder-to-shoulder at the 7th Newport Jazz Festival held in Rotterdam's then-recently built concert venue De Doelen. These four masterful groups consisted of alto saxophonist "Cannonball" Adderley and his quintet (Nat Adderley on cornet, George Duke on keyboards, Walter Booker on bass, and Roy McCurdy on drums), Hammond organist Jimmy Smith and his band (Art Farmer on flugelhorn, Illinois Jacquet on tenor saxophone, Kenny Burrell on guitar, Clark Terry on trumpet, and Roy Haynes on drums), pianist Dave Brubeck and his trio (Jack Six on bass, Alan Dawson on drums) with accompaniment from Paul Desmond on alto saxophone and Gerry Mulligan on baritone saxophone, and bassist Charles Mingus and his group (Joe Gardner on trumpet, Hamiet Bluiett on baritone saxophone, John Foster on piano, Roy Brooks on drums) with the great high-note trumpeter Cat Anderson as a guest.
programme.title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F

programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano, Lugano, Switzerland. Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.
programme.title: Children of the Night
Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano, Lugano, Switzerland. Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano. The one-man musical force stunned the audience with his unique vocal percussion as he delved into the crowd for this quirky and charming act.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, The Walk
programme.desc: . In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic âstretch musicâ; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuahâs quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.desc: American jazz vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performs with his big band at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen in 1983.

programme.desc: Het Milt Jackson Jazz Quartet kwam in 1952 voort uit de ritmesectie van Dizzy Gillespie's bigband en liet zich inspireren door klassieke kamermuziek en de bluesy wortels van de jazz. Als het 'Modern Jazz Quartet' genoot het viertal een decennialange.
programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet - Live Concert
Billie Holiday
programme.desc: Various locations. âGod Bless The Childâ, âFoolinâ Myselfâ, and âI Loves You, Porgyâ: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. âLady Dayâ, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice. Her vocals, which were strongly inspired by instrumental jazz, are admired for their deeply personal and intimate sound. This compilation features recordings from the 1950s of Billie Holiday singing a string of her greatest successes. Enjoy this unique footage of one of jazzâs all-time greats.

programme.title: Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: The Mars Club, Paris, France. This vintage program, âJazz Marmaladeâ, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter âBigâ Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907â1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life. From the American-owned Mars Club just off the Champs-ĂlysĂSes, a hangout for showbiz people and expatriate Americans in Paris, the program cuts to the Blue Note. There, a Paris-based American quartet that includes drummer Kenny Clarke, organ player Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas performs âSalut Les Copinesâ. Returning to the Mars Club, the American jazz trio of house pianist Art Simmons (1926â2018) performs a jaunty take on âC-Jam Bluesâ. Rounding off the program at the Blue Note, the quartet of drummer Kenny Clarke, organist Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas returns for a swinging âApril in Parisâ. These recordings offer an invaluable glimpse into expatriate American jazz-making in Paris in the early 1960s.

programme.desc: Singer Concertzaal, Laren. Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.
programme.title: Adagio from Concierto de Aranjuez

programme.desc: Dinant, Belgium. A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as âBeanâ and âHawkâ serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jonesâ âChantâ and J. J. Johnsonâs âWee Dotâ.
programme.title: Coleman Hawkins live in Belgium, 1962

programme.desc: Jazzahead!, Bremen, Germany. Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the worldâs largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canadaâs jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the ensembles appearing at jazzahead! 2022 is saxophonist Melissa Aldanaâs quartet. Chilean-born Melissa Aldana (1989) studied at Berklee College of Music in Boston, Massachusetts, and, in 2013, became the first female instrumentalist â and the first South American musician â to win the Thelonious Monk International Jazz Saxophone Competition. Her album âVisionsâ earned the saxophonist her first Grammy nomination. She is accompanied by Lage Lund (guitar), Pablo Menares (bass), and Kush Abadey (drums).
programme.title: jazzahead! 2022
Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: Kurhaus Scheveningen, The Hague, Netherlands. The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen. Accompanied by his big band, which included talents such as saxophonist Arnett Cobb, the "King of Vibes" gave an invigorating performance with both mallets and voice.

In pianist, composer and arranger Kathrine Windfeldâs breathtaking compositions, sophisticated harmonic passages meet driving grooves and poetic ballads. Her 15-piece band effortlessly combines playful precision and enthusiastic power. The trumpeters are AndrĂS Bak, Rolf Thofte LĂ¸kke, and Magnus Oseth; the trombonists are GĂśran Abelli, Tobias Stavngaard, and Anders Larson. programme.desc: Montreal Jazz Festival. The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform âChickenâ, âDonna Leeâ, âMr. Phone Boneâ, and âFannie Maeâ. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastoriusâs electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982.

programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival, Den Haag, The Netherlands. The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festivalâs staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, Cuban trumpeter Arturo Sandoval brought his band with him to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Featuring talented performers like pianist Hilario DurĂĄn and guitarist Jorge Chicoy, they displayed a master class in Latin jazz fusion.

programme.desc: BIRD, Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Rotterdamâs â BIRDâ is a club, cafĂS and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name âBIRDâ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programmes: âBIRD.tvâ, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from a first row seat! In todayâs episode Shayna Steele, who can do everything: from background singing with Rihanna via the big Broadway Show on to guest songstress on hit singles by Moby. In order to do so much at once, a versatile voice is a must. And it is exactly this versatility that the American songstress delivers at her concerts, without ever losing the musical direction. From swinging acoustic Samba to storming guitar funk, everything fits like a mould. Presented with a generous portion of charm and impressive dynamic.

programme.title: Tell Me Why
programme.desc: 's-Hertogenbosch, The Netherlands. Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love. In 1980 she enrolled at Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School of Music & Art and Performing Arts in New York City, known from the film 'Fame'. During this time, she appeared as an extra in the legendary comedy film 'Ghostbusters'. Musicals and tours with the bands of Diana Ross and Michael Bolton followed.

programme.desc: Various locations. This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legendsâ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomeryâs virtuosity as he performs the captivating âNica's Dreamâ in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of âHere's That Rainy Dayâ, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's âYou Stepped Out of a Dreamâ and âYou Turned The Tables on Meâ, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform âExtensionsâ in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of âI'm Getting Sentimental Over Youâ from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrockâs avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of âPeanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of âMemphis Undergroundâ from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!
programme.title: Jim Hall & Atilla Zoller - Extensions

programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano, Lugano, Switzerland. Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 1, 1986, guitarist John McLaughlin, saxophonist Bill Evans, drummer Danny Gottlieb, pianist Jim Beard, and bassist Jonas Hellborg continued the Mahavishnu Orchestra's sixteen-year legacy of impressive jazz fusion at the Estival Jazz Lugano.
programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra - Estival Jazz Lugano

programme.desc: Montreal Jazz Festival. The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform âChickenâ, âDonna Leeâ, âMr. Phone Boneâ, and âFannie Maeâ. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastoriusâs electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!
programme.title: Jaco Pastorius

programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival, Den Haag, The Netherlands. The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festivalâs staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, influential American pianist and composer McCoy Tyner brought an all-star cast with him to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Joined by the illustrious trumpeter Freddie Hubbard and saxophonist Joe Henderson, alongside his rhythm section of Avery Sharpe on bass and Louis Hayes on drums, they put on a magical performance that enamored the crowd.
programme.title: Tyner, Hubbard & Henderson - North Sea Jazz

programme.desc: Edison Jazz Awards, The Netherlands. These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.desc: Jazzahead!, Bremen, Germany. Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canadaâs jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the performing bands is the FranĂ§ois Bourassa Quartet. With ten albums of original music and multiple awards, jazz pianist FranĂ§ois Bourassa is an international ambassador for Canadaâs thriving jazz community. Taking inspiration from a diversity of sources, this award-winning quartet has been a staple of Montrealâs artistic landscape for a quarter of a century. The band features bassist Guy Boisvert, saxophonist AndrĂS Leroux and drummer Guillaume Pilote.

programme.desc: Florida Theater. Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, "Pronounced 'Lh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd" and "Second Helping", live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.
programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - Live From The Florida Theater

programme.desc: Roundhouse, London. Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: "Aura"; "MANiCURE"; "Artpop"; "Jewels N' Drugs" ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista; "Sexxx Dreams", "Swine"; and "I Wanna Be With You", a song that transformed into "Dope" for ARTPOP. During the concert, captured stunningly in HD, Gaga says that she's "a bit like Dorothy right now." The stage is her Kansas, the crowd is her family, and their reunion is pure magic. Lady Gaga, her dancers, and her band traverse through visual and musical themes of love, sex, violence, beauty, danger, empowerment, hustle, lust, and above all ART. Throughout, Gaga lays her heart bare for the audience and the cameras with every note sung and every word spoken.
programme.title: Lady Gaga - Live in London 2013

Featuring the classic Foreigner line-up of Jones, Gramm, McDonald, Greenwood, Gagliardi and Elliott, this show captures the essence of a group who would go on to become one of the best-selling bands of all time. On April 27 1978, after their self-titled debut album had spent a year in the US Top 20, rock's conquering heroes played a sold-out show at London's legendary music venue, the Rainbow Theatre. Opening with 'Long, Long Way From Home', the band's legion of fans were treated to a magnificent display of musicianship and performance, including local hit singles, 'Feels Like The First Time' and 'Cold As Ice', as well as an exclusive preview of two tracks from the upcoming 'Double Vision' album. Forty years on, this definitive performance by the original band has been restored from the original film reels, remixed and remastered for this release.

programme.desc: Hammersmith Apollo, London. Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, "New Blood - Live In London" captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra. The repertoire mixes cover versions from his "Scratch My Back" album with classic tracks from across his solo career in brand new orchestral arrangements. Gabriel is a renowned live performer and his onstage charisma and instantly recognisable voice combine brilliantly with the orchestral sound palette to breathe a new sense of wonder into familiar songs. As you would expect the concert is also a visual feast, with graphics, animation and imagery blending to enhance and illustrate the music. This is truly a live experience not to be missed.
programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London

programme.desc: USA. The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.
programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits

programme.desc: Saban Theatre, Beverly Hills, California. Filmed in high definition at an exclusive show at the Saban Theatre in Beverly Hills in April 2007, "Songs From The Small Machine" captures Lindsey Buckingham showcasing tracks from his studio album "Seeds We Sow", songs from across his solo career and Fleetwood Mac classics. His distinctive guitar picking style and instantly recognisable voice are joined to his dynamic on stage presence to deliver a show that brings the audience to their feet and leaves them calling for more. Starting with five solo acoustic performances, Lindsey is then joined by his band to rock their way through the rest of the set before a final acoustic encore of "Seeds We Sow" brings a perfect evening to an end.
programme.title: Lindsey Buckingham - Songs From Small Machine: Live in L.A

programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and her friends love to dance - and the Peculiar Purple Pieman of Porcupine Peak is taking advantage of that!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: There's someone...or something strange in the neighborhood and the kids imagine the worst - but Strawberry finds it's a new girl, Blueberry Muffin.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.desc: Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

programme.desc: Małżeństwo Brian i Randi Johnsonowie wiodą spokojne życie w Eau Claire, wychowując piątkę dzieci. Są głęboko wierzący i blisko ze sobą związani. Brian jest zdolnym majsterkowiczem i założył kilka firm. Życiem rodziny wstrząsa wiadomość o wykryciu raka piersi u Randi. Kobieta przechodzi mastektomię. By znowu mogła poczuć się dobrze w swojej skórze, Brian tworzy dla niej protezę sutka. Jest ona tak realistyczna, że para zakłada biznes, który zmienia życie setek kobiet. Reżyserem i narratorem dokumentu jest syn pary, Justin "Superstar" Johnson. Stworzył intymny, poruszający i zarazem zabawny obraz o swoich bliskich i ich niezwykłym przedsięwzięciu.
programme.title: Mom & Dad's Nipple Factory

programme.desc: Punktem wyjścia opowieści o gryzoniach, jest problem plagi szczurów, która dotknęła Baltimore oraz wiele innych miast. O zwierzętach opowiadają ludzie, którzy je kochają, mieszkają z nimi, ale też zabijają je.
programme.title: Film o szczurach

programme.desc: E218 Kulisy powstawaniu najgłośniejszych, najbardziej popularnych filmów. Widzowie poznają ich budżet oraz zobaczą, jak przebiega praca na planie. Wszystko to wydarzy się w niecałe siedem minut.
programme.title: Zoom In

programme.desc: E50 Spotlight.
programme.title: Spotlight

programme.desc: S2 E7 — Emma Thompson Widzowie poznają kulisy kariery i sekrety z prywatnego życia największych hollywoodzkich gwiazd, począwszy od dzieciństwa, aż po czasy współczesne. Pod lupą znajdą się m.in. Michael Douglas, Michelle Pfeiffer, Al Pacino, czy Dustin Hoffman.
programme.title: Close Up 2

programme.desc: S2 E17 Widzowie poznają kulisy kariery i sekrety z prywatnego życia największych hollywoodzkich gwiazd, począwszy od dzieciństwa, aż po czasy współczesne. Pod lupą znajdą się m.in. Michael Douglas, Michelle Pfeiffer, Al Pacino, czy Dustin Hoffman.
programme.title: Close Up 2

programme.desc: Tom Hammond (Danny Huston), mężczyzna w średnim wieku, jest właścicielem księgarni. Ze sklepu, przy okazji kradzieży, znika też najcenniejsza rzecz Toma - zdjęcie, na którym jest razem ze swoim synem Lukiem (Jonah Hauer-King). To dla niego bardzo ważna pamiątka, ponieważ fotografię zrobiono na krótko przed śmiercią Luke'a w zamachu bombowym samolotu. Chłopak leciał nim na spotkanie z ukochaną Bird (Stacy Martin). Utrata zdjęcia przywołuje u Toma wszystkie uczucia, które towarzyszyły mu w tragicznych chwilach. Mężczyzna na nowo przeżywa tamte wydarzenia i ponownie mierzy się z żale po utracie ukochanego dziecka. Scenariusz napisał Simon Astaire na podstawie własnej powieści. Nawiązuje do wydarzeń z 1988 roku, kiedy doszło do zamachu bombowego na pokładzie samolotu Pan Am Flight 103. W jego wyniku zginęło 243 pasażerów, 16 członków załogi oraz 11 mieszkańców miasta Lockerbie, gdzie rozbił się samolot. Danny Huston po obu stronach kamery.
programme.title: The Last Photograph

programme.desc: Ciepły, wiosenny dzień. Poczciwy Kret (Lee Ingleby) opuszcza swoje mieszkanie i wyrusza na wycieczkę nad brzeg rzeki. Na miejscu zaprzyjaźnia się z kochającym wodę Szczurem (Mark Gatiss), który zaprasza go na spływ swoją łódką. Po drodze spotykają Pana Ropucha (Matt Lucas), aroganckiego bogacza i miłośnika szybkich samochodów, który obmyśla właśnie kradzież wymarzonego wozu. Leśni przyjaciele z pomocą mądrego Borsuka (Bob Hoskins) starają się odwieść go od tego pomysłu, jednak bez skutku. Nie pomaga zastosowany wobec Ropucha areszt domowy. Zielony wielbiciel motoryzacji realizuje swój plan i kradnie auto. Zostaje aresztowany i skazany, jednak w kobiecym przebraniu przedostaje się w rodzinne strony. Tu okazuje się, że jego posiadłość zajęło stado łasic. W odzyskaniu domu pomagają mu przyjaciele Szczur, Kret i Borsuk. Adaptacja baśni brytyjskiego pisarza Kennetha Grahame'a.
programme.title: O czym szumią wierzby

programme.desc: Aktor Jeff Bridges wraz z naukowcami i pisarzami prezentuje obraz Ziemi i jej mieszkańców, szukając odpowiedzi na pytania o przyszłość. Dyskutują o tym, jak biologia, fizyka, ekonomia i polityka przyczyniły się do trwających kryzysów, takich jak zmiany klimatyczne i wyczerpywanie się zasobów.
programme.title: Living in the Future's Past

programme.desc: Scenarzysta serialu "Doktor Who", Matthew Jacobs, zaczyna uczęszczać na konwencje poświęcone kultowej serii. Początkowo unikał ich z obawy przed krytyką fanów serialu. Stopniowo przekonuje się, że może niepotrzebnie bał się ich reakcji. Znajduje społeczność, niemal rodzinę, złożoną z wielbicieli, innych pisarzy i aktorów "Doktora Who", którzy doceniają jego wkład poświęcony temu projektowi.
programme.title: Doktor Who to ja

programme.desc: Chicago. Felietonistka Dorothy Dashton (Fiona Loewi) i jej mąż Dick (Cameron Daddo), znany prawnik, prowadzą poranną audycję radiową, która cieszy się dużą popularnością. Pewnego wieczoru, podczas spaceru ulicami miasta, spotykają młodą kobietę, która sprawia wrażenie obłąkanej. Próbują jej pomóc, ale ona wymyka się im i przepada bez śladu. Następnego dnia Dorothy znajduje w jednej z gazet informację o pogrzebie 26-letniej Mony (Paulina Mielech), córki finansisty Fredericka Rankina (Colin Fox). Dziewczyna była kuratorem w muzeum sztuki starożytnej w Chicago, gdzie jej ojciec pełni funkcję prezesa rady nadzorczej. Okazuje się, że na zdjęciu w gazecie widnieje ta sama kobieta, którą Dick i Dorothy widzieli poprzedniego wieczoru. Ku ich zdziwieniu Mona popełniła samobójstwo w przeddzień ich spotkania z nią. Małżonkowie postanawiają rozwiązać tajemniczą zagadkę. Przy okazji wpadają na trop afery związanej z wywożeniem bezcennych zbiorów z muzeum za granicę.
programme.title: Drive Time Murders

programme.desc: Pozycja pierwsza.
programme.title: Pozycja pierwsza

programme.desc: Zbliża się II wojna światowa. Amerykański pisarz Francis Scott Fitzgerald (Jeremy Irons) pracuje nad swoją ostatnią powieścią pt. "Ostatni z wielkich". Walczy z wywołanymi alkoholem przywidzeniami, w których nawiedza go jego żona Zelda (Sissy Spacek). Osamotniony mężczyzna znajduje zrozumienie i pocieszenie u swojej sekretarki, początkującej autorki Frances Kroll (Neve Campbell). Wkrótce kobieta staje się zaufaną powiernicą twórcy. Historia ostatnich dni życia F. Scotta Fitzgeralda, autora m.in. "Wielkiego Gatsby'ego".
programme.title: Ostatnie wołanie

programme.desc: Annie Garrett (Julie Benz) przeprowadza się wraz z mężem Rossem (John Livingston) i siedmioletnią córką Taylor (Gage Golightly) z Kolorado na ranczo w północnej Kalifornii. Zostawia swoich rodziców, którzy przed laty stracili drugą córkę, Kate. Po dotarciu na miejsce Ross porzuca rodzinę. Pozostawiona bez pieniędzy i przyjaciół Annie, która w dodatku musi utrzymać ukochanego konia, Tola, podejmuje pracę na farmie u Mary Lou O'Brian (Marsha Mason) jako hodowca i trener koni. Ma nadzieję, że to zajęcie pozwoli jej zapomnieć o miłosnym rozczarowaniu. Aby poradzić sobie z kłopotami finansowymi, Annie postanawia wziąć udział w prestiżowych wyścigach konnych. Niestety, okazuje się, że jej koń oślepł. Kobieta postanawia przywrócić zwierzęciu zdrowie.
programme.title: The Long Shot

programme.desc: Kate Mayer (Leslie Hope) mieszka w eleganckim domu na przedmieściach wraz z dwojgiem dzieci i oddanym mężem Jackiem (D.W. Moffett). Nie jest jednak szczęśliwa jako gospodyni domowa i matka. Decyduje się więc na separację z mężem. Po pewnym czasie podejmuje pracę w małej agencji nieruchomości. Szybko zaprzyjaźnia się ze swoją szefową McNally Hays (Wendy Crewson). Niedługo potem obie panie zaczynają darzyć się głębszymi uczuciami. Kate jest zakłopotana swoją miłością do kobiety.
programme.title: Niespodziewana miłość

programme.desc: Rodzice dorastającej Bianci (Manuela Martell) giną w wypadku samochodowym. Dziewczyna musi zaopiekować się młodszym bratem Thomasem (Luigi Ciardo). Ten nawiązuje znajomość z chłopakami, których poznaje na siłowni. Nowi koledzy pomiatają nim. Jakiś czas później Thomas próbuje namówić Biankę, żeby zamieszkali z jego znajomymi. Żeby zdobyć pieniądze, postanawiają oni okraść byłego filmowego gwiazdora, Maciste (Rutger Hauer). Zadanie powierzają Biance.
programme.title: Il Futuro

programme.desc: S2 E7 Mija sześć miesięcy od rozwiązania ostatniej sprawy przez Amandę Pharrell i Teda Conkaffeya. Ich nowe dochodzenie dotyczy zagadkowego morderstwa i siatki handlarzy egzotycznymi narkotykami. Podczas śledztwa Amanda musi się zmierzyć się z dawnym wrogiem. Z kolei Teda dopadają sprawy z przeszłości, które przynoszą śmiertelne konsekwencje.
programme.title: Troppo 2

programme.desc: S2 E7 Dwie silne kobiety: agentka MI6 Eve (Sandra Oh) oraz zabójczyni Villanelle (Jodie Comer), prowadzą ze sobą wyrafinowaną grę. Obie mają obsesję na swoim punkcie. Drugi sezon wciągającej i pełnej napięcia opowieści z gwiazdą serialu "Chirurdzy", laureatką dwóch Złotych Globów, Sandrą Oh, w roli głównej.
programme.title: Obsesja Eve 2

programme.desc: Czasy II wojny światowej. Dr Gisella Perl (Christine Lahti), pochodząca z Węgier żydowska lekarka, jest jedną z pierwszych kobiet ginekologów. Podczas niemieckiej okupacji zostaje uwięziona w obozie koncentracyjnym w Auschwitz. Tam Niemcy postanawiają wykorzystać jej zawodowe umiejętności. Czynią ją asystentką zbrodniarza wojennego, dra Mengele (Jonathan Cake), który dokonuje makabrycznych eksperymentów na więźniach. Jednak dzięki nieugiętej postawie i sile charakteru kobiecie udaje się pomóc tysiącom osób. Po wojnie lekarka zostaje oskarżona o kolaborację z nazistami. Film oparty na faktach.
programme.title: Out of the Ashes

programme.desc: Przyjaciele z dzieciństwa, Teel Johnson (Daniel Amerman) i Madison Daniels (Daniela Bobadilla), po kilku latach odnawiają znajomość za pośrednictwem Internetu. Wiele ich różni. Madison jest przebojowa, popularna, wiedzie pozornie idealne życie. Teel jest społecznym wyrzutkiem, bez przyjaciół i wiary we własne siły. Wspólne rozmowy na czacie ponownie zbliżają ich do siebie. Coraz częsciej poruszają ważne dla nich tematy, jak homoseksualizm, wykorzystywanie seksulane czy przemoc. Podczas jednego czatu Teel wyznaje przyjaciółce, dlaczego nękają go rówieśnicy. Dramat w reżyserii Matthew Toronto nakręcono w formie filmu wyświetlanego na ekranie komputera. Opowiadany jest niemal w całości za pomocą czatu wideo za pośrednictwem kamery internetowej i aparatów w smartfonach.
programme.title: Twarzą w twarz

programme.desc: Małżeństwo Brian i Randi Johnsonowie wiodą spokojne życie w Eau Claire, wychowując piątkę dzieci. Są głęboko wierzący i blisko ze sobą związani. Brian jest zdolnym majsterkowiczem i założył kilka firm. Życiem rodziny wstrząsa wiadomość o wykryciu raka piersi u Randi. Kobieta przechodzi mastektomię. By znowu mogła poczuć się dobrze w swojej skórze, Brian tworzy dla niej protezę sutka. Jest ona tak realistyczna, że para zakłada biznes, który zmienia życie setek kobiet. Reżyserem i narratorem dokumentu jest syn pary, Justin "Superstar" Johnson. Stworzył intymny, poruszający i zarazem zabawny obraz o swoich bliskich i ich niezwykłym przedsięwzięciu.
programme.title: Mom & Dad's Nipple Factory

programme.title: Zoom In

programme.desc: Koncert w amfiteatrze Red Rocks w Górach Skalistych w stanie Kolorado z udziałem Micka Fleetwooda i Petera Framptona. Podczas występu zagrano takie przeboje, jak "Dreams", "Talk to Me" czy "Edge of Seventeen".
programme.title: Stevie Nicks: Live at Red Rocks

programme.desc: Po śmierci męża, Martina, Ruth (Doris Roberts), 70-letnia wdowa z Beverly Hills, rozmyśla o nadchodzącej 50. rocznicy ich ślubu. Jej syn Paul (Jeff Marcus) namawia matkę do aktywności. Tymczasem córka Ruth, egoistyczna adwokat Geena (Ann Magnuson), zamierza umieścić matkę w domu opieki. Pewnej nocy Ruth znajduje się w niebezpieczeństwie. Jej życie ratuje Billy (Judy Reyes), bezdomna, niespełniona pisarka, która również straciła męża. Ocalona proponuje jej gościnę w swoim domu. Zaprasza również przyjaciół Billy: Milkbone'a (Omar J. Dorsey), Tunesa (Jim Cody Williams), Maksa (E.J. Callahan), Dallas (Stacy Solodkin) i Rose (Ellen Geer). Ta "rodzina" pozwala Ruth ponownie cieszyć się życiem. Tymczasem jej sąsiedzi nie są zadowoleni z nowych lokatorów i wkrótce wytaczają Ruth proces. Wynajęty przez nich prawnik Todd Preston (Greg Evigan) nie spodziewa się trudności w wygraniu sprawy. Jednak Ruth nie zamierza się łatwo poddać.
programme.title: Our House

programme.desc: Annie Garrett (Julie Benz) przeprowadza się wraz z mężem Rossem (John Livingston) i siedmioletnią córką Taylor (Gage Golightly) z Kolorado na ranczo w północnej Kalifornii. Zostawia swoich rodziców, którzy przed laty stracili drugą córkę, Kate. Po dotarciu na miejsce Ross porzuca rodzinę. Pozostawiona bez pieniędzy i przyjaciół Annie, która w dodatku musi utrzymać ukochanego konia, Tola, podejmuje pracę na farmie u Mary Lou O'Brian (Marsha Mason) jako hodowca i trener koni. Ma nadzieję, że to zajęcie pozwoli jej zapomnieć o miłosnym rozczarowaniu. Aby poradzić sobie z kłopotami finansowymi, Annie postanawia wziąć udział w prestiżowych wyścigach konnych. Niestety, okazuje się, że jej koń oślepł. Kobieta postanawia przywrócić zwierzęciu zdrowie.
programme.title: The Long Shot

programme.desc: E1 Stany Zjednoczone, czasy gorączki złota. Młody Samuel Clemens (Robin Dunne) przeprowadza się do Kalifornii, by dołączyć do poszukiwań cennego kruszcu. Wyprawa jest dla ciekawego świata i obdarzonego bujną wyobraźnią chłopaka nie tylko szansą na wzbogacenie się, ale i źródłem bezcennych doświadczeń. Niebawem rozpoczyna on pracę jako dziennikarz. Po latach zyska sławę, wydając książki pod pseudonimem Mark Twain... Adaptacja autobiograficznej powieści pisarza nazywanego ojcem amerykańskiej literatury.
programme.title: Mark Twain's Roughing it

programme.desc: E2 Pierwsza część filmowej adaptacji autobiograficznej powieści Marka Twain'a. Autor faktom i własnym doświadczeniom nadał klimat, okraszając je obrazami z własnej wyobraźni. Kopalnie srebra i złota w Nevadzie, panorama prerii i lasów Zachodu, rewolwerowcy, zabójcy, i wytrwali traperzy - wszystko w filmie na podstawie książki autora "Przygód Hucka Finna".
programme.title: Mark Twain's Roughing it

programme.desc: Po śmierci męża, Martina, Ruth (Doris Roberts), 70-letnia wdowa z Beverly Hills, rozmyśla o nadchodzącej 50. rocznicy ich ślubu. programme.title: Our House

programme.desc: Adwokat Mike McBride (John Larroquette) udaje się do więzienia na spotkanie z nową klientką, atrakcyjną treserką psów Laurie Carter (Samantha Smith). Kobieta jest podejrzana o udział w zabójstwie swojego byłego kochanka, weterynarza Franka Sinclaira (Richard Lineback). Podczas corocznej wystawy psów w Los Angeles została zauważona, gdy klęczała przy jego ciele z bronią w dłoni. Zmarły był prominentem. Na wystawie pojawił się wraz ze swoją żoną Sarah (Joanna Going). Wbrew poszlakom McBride przypuszcza, że Laurie jest niewinna i została wrobiona w zbrodnię. W rozwiązaniu sprawy pomagają adwokatowi detektywi Roberta Hansen (Marta DuBois) i Phil Newberry (Matt Lutz). Kolejna część cyklu o obrońcy McBridzie. Postać kreuje John Larroquette, również reżyser filmu.
programme.title: McBride: Dogged

programme.desc: Walia, XIX wiek. Do wioski Tregaron przyjeżdża wędrowny cyrk. Największą sensację budzi afrykański słoń, przywieziony przez artystów. Dla Sary (Saran Morgan), córki miejscowego pastora, to niezwykłe wydarzenie. Dziewczyna, wychowana w konserwatywnym środowisku przez owdowiałego ojca (Aneurin Hughes), ma szansę przekonać się, jak wygląda inne życie. Niestety, niektórzy z mieszkańców wioski są oburzeni pojawieniem się cyrku, sądząc, że to sprawka demonów. Obraz wiernie oddaje realia epoki i lokalny koloryt. Aktorzy posługują się w filmie rzadko dziś spotykanym językiem walijskim, co dodaje produkcji autentyczności. Scenariusz napisała aktorka Helen Griffin ("Human Traffic").
programme.title: Y Syrcas

programme.desc: Samotna, bardzo zdolna uczennica liceum, Mary Faith Rapple (Clara Bryant), zakochuje się w Michaelu (Jesse Moss) - tajemniczym mężczyźnie, który przyjeżdża do niewielkiego miasteczka Due East. Niestety, wkrótce ukochany ginie w wypadku samochodowym, a Mary odkrywa, że jest w ciąży. Dziewczyna musi podjąć niezwykle trudną decyzję. Mary chce urodzić dziecko, choć obawia się, że położy to kres jej marzeniom o wyjeździe do college'u. Zdesperowana, zwraca się zatem z prośbą o pomoc do swego owdowiałego ojca Jesse'ego (Robert Forster) oraz ciotki Lizann (Lynda Boyd). Ci jednak doradzają jej podróż do Atlanty i poddanie się aborcji. Niespodziewanie nastolatka znajduje oparcie w osobie Becky (Kate Capshaw), którą mąż porzucił dla młodszej sekretarki i która od tej pory sama wychowuje swoje dzieci... Film powstał na podstawie dwóch powieści Valerie Sayers.
programme.title: Due East

programme.desc: Starzejący się rolnik z Tennessee, Abner Meecham (Hal Holbrook), ucieka z domu starców, gdzie umieścił go jego syn, Paul (Walton Goggins). Mężczyzna powraca na swoją farmę, aby tam w spokoju spędzić resztę życia. Na miejscu odkrywa, że Paul wydzierżawił gospodarstwo rodzinie Choatów, na czele której stoi Lonzo (Ray McKinnon), dawny wróg Abnera. Nowy najemca jest brutalem, który znęca się nad żoną (Carrie Preston) i córką (Mia Wasikowska). Meecham zamierza odzyskać swoją własność. Kiedy żaden z mężczyzn nie zamierza ustąpić, dochodzi do wielu tragicznych zdarzeń. Film powstał w oparciu o opowiadanie Williama Gaya z 2002 roku.
programme.title: Przed zachodem słońca

programme.desc: Po przedwczesnej śmierci męża Shelley Stratton (Catherine Hicks) przeprowadza się wraz z córkami, Alexis (Emily Hirst) oraz adoptowaną Laurie (Alexz Johnson), do ich odległego letniego domu. Chce tam zacząć wszystko od nowa. Ich życie komplikuje pojawienie się bliźniaczki Laurie, o której kobieta nie miały pojęcia.
programme.title: Stranger With My Face

programme.desc: Zombie Alberto stara się żyć jak zwykły człowiek. Nie jest jednak w stanie tuszować rozkładu za pomocą makijażu, a zapachu za pomocą perfum. Podejmuje więc decyzje o opuszczeniu zwykłych ludzi. Będzie mu szczególnie trudno, gdyż ma wśród nich przyjaciela, managera siłowni.
programme.title: Halley

programme.desc: John Rosow (Michael Shannon) jest prywatnym detektywem, który popadł w chorobę alkoholową. Pewnego dnia otrzymuje nowe zlecenie - ma śledzić Harolda Fullmera (Frank Wood), który podróżuje pociągiem z Chicago do Los Angeles. Detektyw podejmuje się tego zadania i już wkrótce zaczyna sobie uświadamiać zaskakującą prawdę o Fullmerze. Mężczyzna okazuje się bowiem domniemaną ofiarą zamachu na World Trade Center. Jeśli Rosow przetransportuje mężczyznę do jego żony, otrzyma wysoką nagrodę, jednak zmuszenie Fullmera do powrotu do życia, która przestało już istnieć, nie będzie wcale prostym zadaniem. Film Noaha Buschela utrzymany jest w klimacie charakterystycznym dla amerykańskiego kina noir. W rolę prywatnego detektywa wcielił się Michael Shannon - aktor znany z roli Johna Givingsa w "Drodze do szczęścia" Sama Mendesa.
programme.title: Uznany za zmarłego

programme.desc: Dwunastoletnia Aviva marzy o macierzyństwie. Wkrótce zachodzi w ciążę z przyjacielem Judah (Robert Agri). Rodzice nie rozumieją jednak jej pragnienia o posiadaniu własnego potomka. Uważają, że ciąża w jej wieku to katastrofa. Zmuszają więc córkę do dokonania aborcji. W wyniku zabiegu Aviva staje się bezpłodna, ale nie jest tego świadoma. Nieszczęśliwa ucieka z domu, szukając następnego ojca dla swojego dziecka. Wdaje się w intymną relację z kierowcą ciężarówki, który zostawia ją samą w motelu. Dziewczynka ucieka do pobliskiego lasu. Wreszcie znajduje schronienie u Mamy Promyczek (Debra Monk) w rodzinie religijnych fanatyków. Są oni zawziętymi obrońcami życia, którzy walcząc o nienarodzone dzieci, stosują drastyczne środki: zabijają lekarzy przeprowadzających aborcje. Okazuje się, że mordercą jest mężczyzna, z którym Aviva spędziła noc w motelu. Pewnego razu Aviva towarzyszy mu podczas zlecenia. Dochodzi do tragedii. Film porusza kontrowersyjne tematy: od aborcji, przez macierzyństwo nieletnich po pedofilię i religijny fundamentalizm. Składa się z szeregu epizodów. W każdym z nich Avivę gra ktoś inny - dorośli i dzieci, mężczyźni i kobiety o różnym kolorze skóry. Obraz był nominowany do Złotego Lwa na MFF w Wenecji.
programme.title: Palindromes

programme.desc: Występ jednej z najważniejszych grup muzycznych lat 60. Zespół Jefferson Airplane związany był z ruchem hippisowskim. Przekształcił się w Jefferson Starship. Pod tą nazwą w nieco innym składzie i ze świeżym repertuarem koncertował na całym świecie. W Kanadzie nie zabrakło przebojów z lat 60., m.in. "White Rabbit" i "Somebody to Love".
programme.title: Jefferson Starship: Live

programme.title: Zoom In

programme.desc: Kamera towarzyszy Tony'emu Banksowi, Philowi Collinsowi, Mike'owi Rutherfordowi oraz ich ekipie podczas prób do trasy koncertowej Last Domino. Pomimo komplikacji i niepewności związanych z globalną pandemią Covid i bez ustalonych dat zespół postanowił poświęcić czas i pieniądze na przygotowanie do chwili, gdy świat wróci do normalności. W filmie ukazano procesy związane z tym przedsięwzięciem, przedstawiono wywiady z zespołem i występy na żywo z koncertu.
programme.title: Genesis: The Last Domino
Sacrifices of the Heart
programme.desc: Kate Weston (Melissa Gilbert) jest adwokatem. Z powodzeniem prowadzi praktykę w Nowym Jorku. Często zajęta pracą, zaniedbuje życie prywatne. Z codziennego rytmu wybija ją wiadomość o chorobie ojca. Brat Kate, Ryan (Cyril O'Reilly), ma nadzieję, że siostra wróci na rodzinną farmę w New Hampshire i namówi ojca do podjęcia leczenia. Niestety, rodzinne spotkanie kończy się kłótnią i wyciąganiem bolesnych wspomnień z przeszłości. Kate przypomina sobie o samobójczej śmierci matki, o którą od dzieciństwa obwiniała ojca. Wbrew oczekiwaniom, obserwując rodzica, któremu choroba odbiera pamięć, postanawia poznać prawdę o życiu swojej rodziny.
